title: Configuring lychee checks
text: lychee.toml file lychee_options() argument set thing: fields (timeout, max_retries, accept, user_agent, …), whatever pass lychee_options() wins file, file wins lychee-lib’s built-default. exclude, include, header, two sources combined rather one replacing – URL excluded either file function call excluded. example writes lychee.toml excludes port 9001, calls check_urls() exclude port 9002. URLs end excluded, possible file argument merged rather one overriding . Nothing touches network – 9001/9002 localhost never listened , check deterministic offline-safe. rows report is_success = FALSE details explaining excluded – connection failed – confirming pattern file pattern lychee_options() applied.
code: project_dir <- withr::local_tempdir() writeLines('exclude = ["9001"]', file.path(project_dir, "lychee.toml"))  withr::with_dir(project_dir, {   check_urls(     c("http://localhost:9001/aaa", "http://localhost:9002/bbb"),     options = lychee_options(exclude = "9002")   ) }) #>                         url is_success code #> 1 http://localhost:9001/aaa      FALSE   NA #> 2 http://localhost:9002/bbb      FALSE   NA #>                                details #> 1 This is due to your 'exclude' values #> 2 This is due to your 'exclude' values

code: lychee_toml <- ' exclude = ["\\\\.local", "^https://internal\\\\."] timeout = 20 max_retries = 3 accept = ["200..=204", "429"]  [header] Accept = "text/html" ' writeLines(lychee_toml, file.path(project_dir, "lychee.toml")) withr::with_dir(project_dir, {   check_urls(c("http://svc.local", "https://internal.example.com")) }) #>                            url is_success code #> 1             http://svc.local      FALSE   NA #> 2 https://internal.example.com      FALSE   NA #>                                details #> 1 This is due to your 'exclude' values #> 2 This is due to your 'exclude' values check_package(".")

title: Configure optional lychee behaviour — lychee_options
text: Builds options object accepted check_url(), check_urls(), check_paths(), check_package(). Every argument shares name matching field lychee.toml file – configuration file read 'lychee' CLI. lychee.toml present current working directory picked automatically; values passed take precedence file, file takes precedence 'lychee-lib's defaults, exclude/include/ header combined file rather replacing .

title: Configure optional lychee behaviour — lychee_options
code: lychee_options(   exclude = character(),   include = character(),   timeout = NULL,   max_redirects = NULL,   max_retries = NULL,   retry_wait_time = NULL,   user_agent = NULL,   method = NULL,   accept = character(),   exclude_all_private = NULL,   exclude_private = NULL,   exclude_link_local = NULL,   exclude_loopback = NULL,   require_https = NULL,   include_mail = NULL,   header = NULL )

title: Configure optional lychee behaviour — lychee_options
text: exclude Character vector regular expressions. URLs matching pattern treated excluded rather checked. include Character vector regular expressions. URLs matching pattern always checked, even also match exclude. timeout Request timeout seconds, NULL use default (20). max_redirects Maximum number redirects follow, NULL use default (10). max_retries Maximum number retries per request, NULL use default (3). retry_wait_time Initial wait time seconds retries, NULL use default (1). user_agent User agent string sent every request, NULL use lychee's default. method single HTTP method, e.g. "get" "head", NULL use default ("get"). accept Character vector accepted status codes/ranges, e.g. c("200..=204", "429"). Defaults lychee's accepted range empty. exclude_all_private Single logical. Exclude private, link-local, loopback IP addresses, NULL. exclude_private Single logical. Exclude private IP addresses, NULL. exclude_link_local Single logical. Exclude link-local IP addresses, NULL. exclude_loopback Single logical. Exclude loopback IP addresses, NULL. require_https Single logical. Treat unencrypted HTTP links errors HTTPS available, NULL. include_mail Single logical. Also check mailto: links, NULL. header Named character vector custom HTTP headers sent every request, NULL.

title: rambutan: Fast Link Checking Powered by 'lychee' — rambutan-package
text: Windows, R process can exit non-zero status (native STATUS_STACK_BUFFER_OVERRUN crash) rambutan call already completed successfully returned result. happens process/DLL teardown, link check – calling check_url(), check_urls(), check_paths(), check_package() interactively returns correct results every time. matters non-interactive use exit code R process checked, e.g. Rscript -e 'rambutan::check_url(...)' CI step batch script. underlying cause likely transitive TLS dependency (aws-lc-rs, via rustls) rather rambutan's code, something fixable directly; may resolve future upstream update.
